lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Everyone,

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I thought of something super duper fun!

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: What is it?
What's up?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: You know how Nero is always saying

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: "meow" at the end of her sentences?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I figured we all should do the same.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I'll say

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: "woof".

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: What about me?

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: How about "graul"?

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Hehe, this is kinda fun, graul.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: You sound like you're choking on something, meow.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: What about you, Trainer?
I have to do it as well?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Of course, woof!
I can't really think of anything.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I've got it.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Remember that dog we mentioned before, graul?

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: The one that looks like Scoops?
Sure, I remember.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: How about we use the sound of his bark?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: That's a great idea, woof!

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: In that case, you should go with "hwwwaaah", Trainer.
All right, fine... hwwwaaah.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Hehe, so cute.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: But why are we doing this to begin with, graul?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: If we talk like this,

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I think the consistency of it

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: will make for a nice team-building exercise, woof.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Woof...

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I'm... not so sure about that, graul.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Yeah... now that we're actually trying it out, you may be right, woof.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: It doesn't feel this forced when Nero does it, woof.
Right, hwwwaaah.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: That's because "meow" is its own unique thing, meow.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Why don't you try it?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Just add meow to the end of our sentences?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: As simple as this, meow?

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Of course not, meow.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: There's an art to it, meow.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Wow, seems like there are all kinds of different ways to use it.
I guess there's a reason only Nero can get away with doing it.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Precisely.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: I'm inimitable, meow.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I need to do a bit more research.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Thanks for trying this out with me, everyone!
